cases.question: ¿Cuántos asientos registrados hubo por diario en abril de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT je.book, COUNT(*) AS total FROM journal_entry je WHERE je.status = TRUE AND je.entry_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND je.entry_date < DATE '2026-05-01' GROUP BY je.book ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT je.book AS diario, COUNT(*) AS total_asientos FROM public.journal_entry AS je WHERE (je.entry_date >= CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND je.entry_date < CAST('2026-05-01' AS DATE)) AND je.status = TRUE GROUP BY je.book LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Qué asientos registrados no cuadraron entre debe y haber en abril de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT je.id, je.code, je.entry_date, SUM(jed.debit) AS total_debe, SUM(jed.credit) AS total_haber FROM journal_entry je JOIN journal_entry_detail jed ON jed.entry_id = je.id WHERE je.status = TRUE AND je.entry_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND je.entry_date < DATE '2026-05-01' GROUP BY je.id, je.code, je.entry_date HAVING ABS(SUM(jed.debit) - SUM(jed.credit)) > 0.01 ORDER BY je.entry_date DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT je.code AS code, je.entry_date AS entry_date, COALESCE(SUM(jed.debit), 0) AS total_debit, COALESCE(SUM(jed.credit), 0) AS total_credit FROM public.journal_entry AS je JOIN public.journal_entry_detail AS jed ON jed.entry_id = je.id WHERE (je.entry_date >= CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND je.entry_date < CAST('2026-05-01' AS DATE)) AND je.status = TRUE GROUP BY je.id, je.code, je.entry_date HAVING COALESCE(SUM(jed.debit), 0) <> COALESCE(SUM(jed.credit), 0) LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuál fue el saldo neto del elemento contable 4 en abril de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(jed.debit), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(jed.credit), 0) AS saldo FROM journal_entry je JOIN journal_entry_detail jed ON jed.entry_id = je.id JOIN accounting_account aa ON aa.id = jed.account_id WHERE je.status = TRUE AND aa.code LIKE '4%' AND je.entry_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND je.entry_date < DATE '2026-05-01' LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuánto sumaron el debe y el haber por tipo de cuenta en abril de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT aa.type, SUM(jed.debit) AS total_debe, SUM(jed.credit) AS total_haber FROM journal_entry je JOIN journal_entry_detail jed ON jed.entry_id = je.id JOIN accounting_account aa ON aa.id = jed.account_id WHERE je.status = TRUE AND je.entry_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND je.entry_date < DATE '2026-05-01' GROUP BY aa.type ORDER BY aa.type LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT aa.type AS tipo_cuenta, COALESCE(SUM(jed.debit), 0) AS total_debe, COALESCE(SUM(jed.credit), 0) AS total_haber FROM public.journal_entry_detail AS jed JOIN public.journal_entry AS je ON jed.entry_id = je.id JOIN public.accounting_account AS aa ON jed.account_id = aa.id WHERE (je.entry_date >= CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND je.entry_date < CAST('2026-05-01' AS DATE)) AND je.status = TRUE GROUP BY aa.type LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuántos periodos contables abiertos abarcan abril de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM accounting_period ap WHERE ap.status = 'OPEN' AND ap.start_date < DATE '2026-05-01' AND ap.end_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuál fue el total de comprobantes emitidos en mayo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(si.total_amount), 0) AS total FROM sales_invoice si WHERE si.status = 'Issued' AND si.issued_at >= DATE '2026-05-01' AND si.issued_at < DATE '2026-06-01' LIMIT 50
